(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Crown Point Technologies, LLC provides software development and data engineering solutions to government and commercial clients. The Junior Software Engineer helps design, develop, test, and maintain software applications alongside experienced engineers.
Junior software engineer developing, testing, debugging, and maintaining software applications

Responsibilities:
• Write and maintain clean, efficient code
• Assist in developing and testing software applications
• Troubleshoot and debug issues
• Collaborate with team members on development tasks
• Participate in code reviews and team meetings

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience)
• Basic knowledge of a programming language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, or C#)
• Familiarity with Git or other version control tools
• Strong problem-solving and communication skills
